name: Aizumi Kouki
source:
"Let me get more intoxicated on your sweet melody."

He is the owner and manager of the share house "Sakurajo" and organizer of the secret members-only live show "Own The Night". 

Once a businessman, he is now a wealthy man and investor who basically stays at home. Serving delicious food to everyone is now his hobby. He supports young people with the idea that music was and still is free.

[Translated from [url=https://ikemen.cybird.ne.jp/title/live/original/character/aizumi_koki.html]official website[/url]]
